question: Do any PlatformSnapshot .audit / .idempotency read-sites require full cross-session historical content for correctness during a write-only, purely-additive CAP1000 install?
method: Repo-wide ripgrep of snapshot()/currentSnapshot()/viewSnapshot()/snap.audit|idempotency read patterns across packages/ and apps/; then classify each hit for install-path correctness dependency.

installPathChokepoint.behaviour: Every command: const snap = this.store.snapshot() (full structuredClone); optional snap.idempotency.find(key === input.idempotencyKey); writeAudit pushes; store.replace(snap) which clones again inside PostgresPlatformStore.replace.

auditReadSites.role: projectOperationalAudit / listAudit / exportAudit filter by organisation; writeAudit append-only
auditReadSites.notes: Query/export APIs are not invoked by capacity-live-install. writeAudit only appends.

auditReadSites.role: persistTransactional inserts audit rows whose id is absent from previous.audit; never deletes missing historical audit
auditReadSites.notes: Empty in-memory audit at open still persists newly written session audits; historical DB rows remain untouched.

auditReadSites.role: finds audit by action for EEC probes
auditReadSites.notes: Not on CAP1000 live install path.

auditReadSites.role: reports audit length; excludes audit from cleanup

idempotencyReadSites.role: snap.idempotency.find by the CURRENT command's idempotencyKey for replay / conflict
idempotencyReadSites.notes: Needs exact keys under this installer's prefix (cap1000-live-%). Foreign keys are never consulted for CAP1000 install commands.

idempotencyReadSites.role: persistTransactional inserts idempotency keys absent from previous.idempotency; never deletes missing keys

idempotencyReadSites.notes: Not used by CAP1000 seating product install.

scopedBehaviourAuthorised.platformDocuments: unchanged (Phase 1: single largest source is platform_audit; largest document collection operationalGuests is secondary)
